text: 4 things you should never forgive in a relationship My channel is mostly for men, that's why this video will be structured from a man's perspective. But if you are a woman watching this, the same principles apply in reverse. Let's go straight to the point. First thing you should never forgive in a relationship is cheating. This one is obvious, but it still needs to be said. If your woman cheats on you and you forgive her, the relationship doesn't get better. Why? Because forgiving cheating sends one very clear message. You don't respect yourself. And if you don't respect yourself, your woman won't respect you either. Respect is the foundation of any relationship. Once it's gone, promises don't matter. Tears don't matter. Explanations don't matter. You break up, you move on, and you do not look back. Second thing you should never forgive in a relationship is flirting with other men behind your back. This is emotional cheating, and it is just as serious. If your woman is texting other men, flirting, sending photos, keeping conversations secret, that is betrayal. Whether or not there was physical contact doesn't change the principle. Loyalty is not only about sex. It's about boundaries. If your woman respects you, she doesn't seek attention from other men. And if you respect yourself, you do not tolerate such behavior. Forgiving this teaches her that your boundaries are flexible. And flexible boundaries get crossed again. Third thing you should never forgive in a relationship is comparing you to other men. Especially to her exes. If your woman compares you to her ex, to a boyfriend of her friend, or to other men, and tells you that you are not enough, that someone else is better, that is pure disrespect. In a healthy relationship, you should be the best man for your woman, and she should be the best woman for you. That doesn't mean you are perfect. It means you choose each other fully. When she compares you to other men, she is telling you that she's already looking outside the relationship, at least mentally. Now, if something slips out once in a very tight way, and everything else in the relationship is great, you might address it and set a boundary. But if this becomes a pattern, my ex did this better, why can't you be like him, other men do this, that's it. That relationship is already over. And the same applies in reverse. If you genuinely think your woman is not enough for you, do not humiliate her. Don't compare her to other women. Just leave and find someone who fits you better. First thing that you should never forgive in a relationship is lying. I'm not talking about small, everyday situations, like her saying she's not hungry, but then also joining you for a meal when you order something for her. I'm talking about big lies, especially lies that involve other men. For example, she tells you she's going to meet a friend for a coffee, and later, you find out she went clubbing or partying, and she didn't even think to tell you. That shows a lack of respect, a lack of transparency, and a lack of consideration for you. If she lies about things that matter, how can you trust her? And without trust, there is no relationship. But why forgiving these things makes it worse? A lot of men believe that forgiveness will make the relationship stronger. In reality, it often has the opposite effect. This works like bullying. Bullies don't stop because someone forgives them. They stop when there are consequences. If a person learns that they can cross your boundaries and nothing happens, they will keep crossing them. The same applies in relationships. Forgiving betrayal, disrespect, and lies doesn't make you noble. It makes you predictable and easy to disrespect. If she doesn't respect you and you forgive behavior that destroys respect, the relationship will only get worse. Overall, these are four things you should never forgive in a relationship. Cheating, talking to other men behind your back, comparing you to other men, and lying. If any of these happen, the correct response is not endless talking, not hoping, not fixing. It's breaking up and moving on. By doing that, you don't just protect your dignity. You give yourself a chance to become a better man and eventually find a woman who respects you, values you, and treats you properly.
